strings.achievement.all_roads.desc: Bring 35 foreign cities into your realm.
strings.achievement.arborist.desc: Plant two hundred and fifty trees.
strings.achievement.cartographer_fog.desc: Uncover two hundred stretches of the world.
strings.achievement.confederacy.desc: Bring 20 foreign cities into your realm.
strings.achievement.empire_of_five.desc: Have five foreign cities in your realm.
strings.achievement.federation.desc: Bring 10 foreign cities into your realm.
strings.achievement.first_merge.desc: Merge a 2x2 block into a single larger building.
strings.achievement.first_neighbour.desc: Bring a foreign city into your realm.
strings.achievement.good_neighbour.desc: Bring a second foreign city into your realm.
strings.achievement.landscaper.desc: Reshape your first tile of land.
strings.achievement.world_walker.desc: Uncover two thousand stretches of the world.

strings.build.title: Construction
strings.building.adobe_hut.desc: A cheap clay house under a canvas awning. Needs only a little water — build it within reach of a well.
strings.building.adobe_yard.desc: Rows of bricks drying in the sun. Turns clay and water into adobe — Dune's main building material.
strings.building.aerogel_kiln.desc: A kiln with milky blue blocks: it makes aerogel, light as a cloud, from dust and hydrogen.
strings.building.aeroponic_farm.desc: Hanging green curtains in the mist: food without soil.
strings.building.air_scrubber.desc: An air scrubber. Pulls out the smoke the furnaces and plants made.
strings.building.airfield.desc: An airfield. Caravans reach further and faster.
strings.building.airport.desc: A full airport. Links to cities a caravan would need weeks to reach.
strings.building.airship_dock.desc: The Aether's port: a tower with a moored airship. Sets how much helium and fiber leave along trade routes, and airships link distant decks like a ferry.
strings.building.antigrav_anchor.desc: A ring levitating over the deck: huge lift from metallic hydrogen, burning nothing.
strings.building.apartment.desc: An apartment block. From here the city grows up, not out.
strings.building.archipelago_lander.desc: The colony on its first island: housing for thirty, storage, a little food and bamboo. Keeps a link to the ship in orbit.
strings.building.arcology.desc: A city in one building: homes, work and greenery under one roof.
strings.building.ash_farm.desc: Dark fields with green rows. On set lava after an eruption the ash is fertile — a farm next to a basalt field yields up to twice as much.
strings.building.aurora_observatory.desc: A telescope dome beneath the aurora: science and a happier neighbourhood.
strings.building.bakery.desc: A bakery. Flour becomes bread — the most filling food of the early game.
strings.building.bamboo_grove.desc: A dense green grove: bamboo for building, stilts and rope. Grows best in the jungle.
strings.building.basalt_hut.desc: Cheap housing built from hexagonal basalt columns. Four side by side can be merged into a terrace house.
strings.building.basalt_quarry.desc: Breaks basalt columns into blocks — the Forge's main building material. Yields more on set lava and volcanic wastes.
strings.building.bastion.desc: An upgraded tower: twice the range and a shot that hurts.
strings.building.biocrystal_hatchery.desc: Crystal geodes with a rainbow shimmer: biocrystals, Xeno's main export and the key to the Constellation.
strings.building.blast_furnace.desc: A blast furnace. Ore and coal in, iron out. The road to steel starts here.
strings.building.botanical_garden.desc: A botanical garden. The most effective green the city has.
strings.building.breakwater.desc: A stone mole wrapped in foam. Shields the nearby shore — the cyclone surf buries nothing here.
strings.building.brick_house.desc: Brick instead of timber: more people, and it does not burn.
strings.building.bronze_smith.desc: A bronze smithy. Tools that outlast wooden ones.
strings.building.canopy_house.desc: Little houses in the crown of a giant bloom, high above the moss.
strings.building.caravanserai.desc: A courtyard full of camels — Dune's port. Trade routes run through it, and it cheers up the neighbourhood.
strings.building.carillon.desc: A carillon. You compose the tune yourself and the city plays it back.
strings.building.cathedral.desc: A cathedral. The most faith and the most goodwill from a single building.
strings.building.charcoal_kiln.desc: A charcoal kiln. Coal from wood — a way into smelting before you find a coal seam.
strings.building.cistern.desc: A low dome holding a store of water. Carries water further from the source and adds a little of its own.
strings.building.city_park.desc: A city park. Green for a whole quarter, not just a street.
strings.building.clay_pit.desc: A wet pit dug for clay. Works only where the ground is damp: in an oasis, on an aquifer, in the steppe.
strings.building.cleansArea: Cleans the surrounding area (while upkeep is paid)
strings.building.clock_tower.desc: A clock tower. Gives the city a rhythm, and something to steer by.
strings.building.cloud_palace.desc: Glass domes and flags in the wind — the densest housing of the Aether. Needs pearls from the Archipelago and glass from Dune.
strings.building.cloud_spire.desc: A slender tower with terraces. Dense, but heavy — it needs more lift.
strings.building.coal_mine.desc: A coal mine. Coal is fuel for everything that smelts.
strings.building.coal_power_plant.desc: A coal power plant. The first electricity in the game, and the first real smoke.
strings.building.computer_plant.desc: A computer plant. Computers drive research and every late build.
strings.building.constellation.desc: The galactic wonder. Six stages, each asking for one world's goods: glass from Dune, crystals from Rime, pearls from the Archipelago, rare earths from Forge, helium-3 from Aether and finally biocrystals from Xeno. When it lights up, the galaxy is one civilisation.
strings.building.copper_mine.desc: A copper mine. Copper leads to bronze, and bronze to the first decent tools.
strings.building.coral_quarry.desc: A platform over the reef: cuts coral stone from reef nearby. Quarried reef bleaches for a while and grows back on its own.
strings.building.cottage.desc: An upgraded house. Twice the people on the same tile.
strings.building.courtyard_house.desc: A house around a shady courtyard with a palm. More people on the same water.
strings.building.crystal_cutter.desc: Cuts frost crystals into cut crystals — for optics, for export and for great buildings.
strings.building.crystal_mine.desc: The blue-lit mouth of an ice cave. Mines frost crystals; freezes without heat.
strings.building.date_grove.desc: Rows of palms that give food. Without water they yield nothing — build them within reach of a well.
strings.building.decontamination_yard.desc: Cleans the soil far faster than time ever would.
strings.building.deep_probe.desc: A winch with a cable vanishing into the depths: metallic hydrogen from the giant's interior. Needs power.
strings.building.deep_sea_port.desc: A deep-sea port. Reaches further than a harbour, and opens the deep.
strings.building.deep_smelter.desc: Smelts nodules into steel and copper on the seabed.
strings.building.depot.desc: A depot for building material. Wood, planks, stone — the things that run out first.
strings.building.desert_observatory.desc: A white dome under the starriest sky in the galaxy. Grinds lenses from glass and produces science.
strings.building.dew_trap.desc: Nets on poles that catch dew at night. Stands anywhere, but gives little — and only after dark.
strings.building.drainage_works.desc: Dries the surrounding swamp into solid buildable ground. Slowly, but without a single click.
strings.building.dune_lander.desc: The ship that settled into the sand. Colonists sleep inside; its recycler gives a little water, food and adobe — enough for day one.
strings.building.dust_collector.desc: Mesh sails into the wind: they catch the carbon dust that becomes fiber and aerogel.
strings.building.electronics_fab.desc: An electronics fab. Silicon into components.
strings.building.factory.desc: A factory. Machine parts at scale — the way into everything that comes later.
strings.building.farm.desc: A basic field. Food is what keeps people alive — without it the city stops growing.
strings.building.ferry_dock.desc: A jetty where a small boat calls. Buildings around it count as connected without a road — the ferry carries goods off the island.
strings.building.fiber_loom.desc: A machine with spools of black thread: it weaves carbon fiber from dust — the Aether's main building material.
strings.building.fiber_nursery.desc: Beds of hair-like strands: living fiber, the main building material of Xeno.
strings.building.fish_drying_rack.desc: Racks of fish in the sun and wind. Turns fish into food for the whole archipelago.
strings.building.fish_pen.desc: Fattens fish on kelp. Food without farmland.
strings.building.fishery.desc: A fishery. Several times what a hut brings in — but it wants a proper coast.
strings.building.fishing_hut.desc: A fishing hut. Must stand by water and lives off what swims in it.
strings.building.fishing_pier.desc: A pier on stilts with nets and boats. The fish go to the drying racks.
strings.building.floating_house.desc: A raft with a house, moored with ropes in shallow water. Denser housing where there's no land.
strings.building.floating_market.desc: Boats laden with goods under sails: the world's port for trade routes, and a market people love.
strings.building.forestry_office.desc: Afforests the plain around it. Woods before the tech tree gets round to them.
strings.building.forge_lander.desc: The colony beneath the volcanoes: housing for thirty, storage, a little food and basalt and a small reactor. Keeps a link to the ship in orbit.
strings.building.forge_smithy.desc: Forges tools from obsidian, and people like to gather at its hearth.
strings.building.fountain_square.desc: A fountain square. Where the city meets.
strings.building.frost_lander.desc: The ship on the ice: homes for the first colonists, a little food and ice, and heat for its surroundings.
strings.building.fungal_dwelling.desc: A grown mushroom with little windows that glows at night. Cheap housing; four side by side grow into a living hive.
strings.building.fusion_beacon.desc: A fusion beacon. Your own sun over the city: power, and a light people come to watch.
strings.building.fusion_plant.desc: A fusion plant. The end of worrying about electricity.
strings.building.gene_lab.desc: An organic dome with a spiral of light: genome and some science from nectar.
strings.building.geothermal_bore.desc: A drilling rig over a hot spring. Plenty of free heat — only on a hot spring.
strings.building.geothermal_plant.desc: Cooling towers wreathed in steam: steady power from the earth's heat.
strings.building.glass_oasis.desc: Dune's wonder: a giant glass dome that holds in moisture. The largest water source on the world, and the desert around it slowly turns green.
strings.building.glassworks.desc: A furnace with a glowing mouth. Melts sand into glass — for mirrors, cisterns and export.
strings.building.glow_field.desc: A field of glowing bulbs: luminsap, and power at night.
strings.building.grain_field.desc: Grain fields. Grain alone is not food — it has to go through mill and bakery.
strings.building.granary.desc: A granary. Room for food and grain, so a good harvest is not thrown away.
strings.building.grand_exchange.desc: A grand exchange. The trading heart of the realm, and the best mood the city can buy.
strings.building.grand_library.desc: A grand library. A monument that also does research.
strings.building.great_pit.desc: A gigantic pit that swallows everything the city has to spare. It never fills up — which is exactly why you keep digging.
strings.building.great_quarry.desc: A merged great quarry. Four quarries in one.
strings.building.great_statue.desc: A great statue. A monument seen from half the city away.
strings.building.great_warehouse.desc: Three times a plain warehouse in one building. Fewer sheds scattered around town.
strings.building.greenhouse.desc: Lichen + heat = food. Glows green at night.
strings.building.grist_mill.desc: A water mill for grain. Turns grain into flour.
strings.building.habitat_dome.desc: A glazed dome for many people. Dense and thrifty with heat.
strings.building.hammam.desc: Little domes full of steam. People nearby are happier — but the baths drink water and want salt.
strings.building.hanging_house.desc: A little house hung on ropes under the edge of the deck: light, and more people live on the same bit of deck.
strings.building.harbor.desc: A harbour. Opens the sea around it — only then can you build on the seabed.
strings.building.healing_grove.desc: A ring of trees wrapped in mist: it heals and soothes.
strings.building.hearth_house.desc: A stone house with a smoking chimney: it burns peat and warms itself and its nearest neighbours.
strings.building.heat_cell_works.desc: Crystal + peat = heat cell: portable heat for heat relays, for export and for the Aether.
strings.building.heat_relay.desc: Burns heat cells and carries heat further — portable heat for distant buildings.
strings.building.helium_separator.desc: Silver tanks with a blue glow: they separate helium-3 from hydrogen — fusion fuel for the whole galaxy and the Aether's main export.
strings.building.high_rise.desc: A high-rise. Seventy people on one tile — a metropolis needs nothing less.
strings.building.hot_springs_spa.desc: Steaming pools in the snow. Lifts the mood of people nearby — especially in the polar night.
strings.building.house.desc: The cheapest roof there is. Put a few up first — nobody works without people.
strings.building.housing_block.desc: A merged residential complex. A whole quarter in one building.
strings.building.hunters_lodge.desc: A hunter's lodge. Food from the wild where no plough goes.
strings.building.hydrogen_lifter.desc: A trio of long envelopes: great lift, as long as hydrogen keeps flowing.
strings.building.hydrogen_scoop.desc: A crane with a hose lowered into the depths: it draws hydrogen from the clouds.
strings.building.hydroponics.desc: Soil-free growing. Food where nothing would grow — desert, tundra, bare rock.
strings.building.ice_house.desc: A dome of ice blocks. Cheap and well insulated — it needs little heat.
strings.building.ice_quarry.desc: Cuts blue blocks of ice — Rime's main building material. Best near a glacier.
strings.building.iron_forge.desc: An iron forge. Five times the tools bronze gives.
strings.building.iron_mine.desc: An iron mine. The ore is useless on its own — it has to go to a blast furnace.
strings.building.irrigation_works.desc: Leads water into the surroundings and turns dry ground into meadow — on its own, tile by tile.
strings.building.kelp_farm.desc: Grows kelp in the shallows near a harbour.
strings.building.kelp_raft.desc: Rafts of kelp in shallow water. The kelp goes to the ropewalk.
strings.building.lagoon_villa.desc: A luxury villa over the lagoon, hung with lanterns. Needs pearls and glass — glass isn't made here, a trade route brings it from Dune.
strings.building.lava_channel.desc: A pyrocrete trough: lava pours in, flows along the bed wherever you lead it and stops at its end. That's how a river of fire is led around the city.
strings.building.lava_view_tower.desc: A slender luxury tower whose windows glow with the lava at night. Needs rare earths and glass — glass isn't made here, a trade route brings it from Dune.
strings.building.lava_wall.desc: A massive basalt wall: lava can't get through and stops in front of it. Build it across the predicted path.
strings.building.library.desc: A library. The first research in the game — nothing unlocks without it.
strings.building.lichen_gatherer.desc: A low hut with baskets: gathers lichen on the tundra. Greenhouses turn it into food.
strings.building.life_tree.desc: A tree with golden light: within its reach the flora keeps growing but wraps nothing — tamed.
strings.building.lift_balloon.desc: A striped balloon on ropes: it carries the bit of city around it. Without lift the buildings would sink into the clouds.
strings.building.lighthouse.desc: A white tower with a turning light. People feel safer at night and boats find their way home.
strings.building.lightning_harvester.desc: A tall mast that sparks in the storm: huge power — but only while a storm band crosses the city.
strings.building.living_hive.desc: A pulsing cellular hive — dense housing that grows with the flora, not against it.
strings.building.log_boom.desc: A log boom on the bank. Pulls out the wood a flume sent down — and more than went in. Without one, floated wood is lost.
strings.building.log_flume.desc: A log flume. Takes wood from storage and floats it downriver — someone downstream has to pull it out.
strings.building.logistics_hub.desc: The late-game automated store. One replaces a dozen warehouses — but it wants power.
strings.building.lumber_camp.desc: Fells the trees around it. When they run out it stops — move it, or plant a grove.
strings.building.lumberyard.desc: A bigger lumber camp. Same work, twice the yield.
strings.building.machine_shop.desc: A machine shop. Parts from iron — the slower road to factories, but no steel needed.
strings.building.magma_tap.desc: A probe over glowing bedrock: huge power for the whole city. Stands only on volcanic ground, and lava can't pass through it.
strings.building.manor.desc: Four houses merged into one. Saves room for something more useful.
strings.building.market.desc: A market. The cheapest way to lift the mood — and a few people live above it.
strings.building.maxLevel: Max level — this is the top tier.
strings.building.megacity_spire.desc: A megacity spire. Houses more people than a whole quarter of tenements.
strings.building.mergeLocked: The merge target isn't researched yet
strings.building.mergeNoBlock: Only a 2×2 block of identical buildings can merge
strings.building.milestoneNext: {0} more to the next tier ({1} built)
strings.building.mine.desc: A shaft into the rock. Twice the stone a quarry gives.
strings.building.monastery.desc: A monastery. Faith and research at once — the monks copy books.
strings.building.nano_forge.desc: A nano forge. Nanomaterial — what megastructures are built from.
strings.building.nectar_garden.desc: Giant blooms heavy with drops of nectar: food. Yields more next to the flora.
strings.building.nodule_harvester.desc: Vacuums ore nodules off the deep seabed.
strings.building.nuclear_plant.desc: Turns uranium into a flood of power — and research on the side. The water pays for it.
strings.building.oasis_palace.desc: Domes, arcades and a pool. The most people on Dune — but it wants spice and a lot of water.
strings.building.obelisk.desc: An obelisk. Marks the centre of town, and people breathe easier near it.
strings.building.billion_pillar.desc: A gold-crowned pillar marking the day a billion people lived in your city. It glows over the centre at night.
strings.building.boulevard_arch.desc: A triumphal arch for a city of three metropolises. The great avenues between them meet beneath it.
strings.building.obsidian_workshop.desc: At the edge of the lava it melts basalt into volcanic glass. Obsidian goes into tools and buildings.
strings.building.optics_workshop.desc: Turns glass imported from Dune and electronics into computers — faster than a computer plant.
strings.building.ore_exchange.desc: The Forge's port: a stone hall with a cable line to orbit. Sets how many rare earths leave along trade routes.
strings.building.pearl_farm.desc: Buoys and nets in the turquoise lagoon. Grows pearls from shells — luxury for housing and export across the galaxy.
strings.building.peat_cutter.desc: Cuts peat — fuel for stoves and generators. Most in a peat bog.
strings.building.peat_stove.desc: A small heat source. It warms as long as it has peat — then it cools and the area freezes.
strings.building.polder.desc: A wind pump and little channels: turns nearby flats and shallows into land, tile by tile. The road to a big city.
strings.building.pruner.desc: A shelled machine with blades: within its reach the flora doesn't grow and wraps nothing — and it harvests spores from it.
strings.building.pyrocrete_dome.desc: A grey dome with copper vents — twice as many people as a hut on the same spot.
strings.building.pyrocrete_mixer.desc: A rotating drum mixes basalt and sulfur into pyrocrete — the stuff of channels, towers and domes.
strings.building.qanat.desc: An underground channel marked by a line of shafts. Carries water far — further than a cistern.
strings.building.quench_tower.desc: Mist from its nozzles chills any lava that comes near: buildings around the tower won't be flooded, and the tower itself is a wall.
strings.building.rare_earth_mine.desc: A shaft into the volcanic veins of the mountains. The ore goes to the refinery.
strings.building.rare_earth_refinery.desc: Tanks and pipes with violet glints: turns ore into rare earths, the Forge's main export. Needs power.
strings.building.reclaimers_statue.desc: A monument to the people who turned water and wasteland into land. It stands by a canal amid a garden.
strings.building.hall_of_wonders.desc: A museum of the seven technical wonders your city built. People come to admire how far they have come.
strings.building.root_network.desc: Glowing roots in the ground: the flora can't grow over them and buildings nearby are connected as if by a road.
strings.building.ropewalk.desc: A long covered walk: twists bamboo and kelp into rope for boats, floating houses and export.
strings.building.round_house.desc: Cheap housing on dry land under a thatched roof. It doesn't belong on the flats — the tide would flood it.
strings.building.salt_pans.desc: White squares on the salt flat that mirror the sky. Salt goes into spice and trade.
strings.building.sand_fence.desc: A fence of reed and clay. Sandstorms won't bury the buildings around it.
strings.building.sand_quarry.desc: A stepped pit in a dune. Sand is for glass.
strings.building.seed_vault.desc: A seed chamber with pulsing pods: a store of spores, fiber and nectar.
strings.building.seismograph.desc: The needle twitches before the volcano wakes: the station shows on the map where the next lava will flow, even when nothing is imminent.
strings.building.serenity_garden.desc: A glowing garden with a pond. People come mostly at night.
strings.building.shell_collector.desc: Baskets on the flats. Not on stilts: underwater at high tide, it only works at ebb.
strings.building.shell_shrine.desc: A white building of coral and shells. Happiness for the neighbourhood; its upkeep is shells.
strings.building.shipyard.desc: A slipway with a hull on it. Long-range ferries connect even distant islands, and it adds capacity to trade routes. Needs power.
strings.building.signal_bloom.desc: Xeno's port: a giant bloom that "sings" to orbit. Sets how many biocrystals leave along trade routes.
strings.building.sky_gallery.desc: A glass walkway over the abyss: the view into the storm makes people happy.
strings.building.sky_lander.desc: The colony in the clouds: housing for thirty, storage, a little food and fiber, a small reactor and the balloons that carry it. The ship brought the first piece of deck along.
strings.building.sky_pod.desc: A light round pod with porthole windows. Cheap housing; four side by side merge into a cloud spire.
strings.building.snowplow_depot.desc: The ploughs roll out when a blizzard nears: buildings nearby won't be buried by snow.
strings.building.solar_mirrors.desc: A field of mirrors around a tower. Gives power — most at noon, none at night and little in a storm.
strings.building.spice_bazaar.desc: Stalls of spice from Dune. A big service for the neighbourhood — as long as a trade route keeps the spice coming.
strings.building.spice_garden.desc: Colourful drip-irrigated terraces. Turns salt, water and power into spice — luxury and export.
strings.building.spore_barrier.desc: A row of glowing pollen posts: the flora can't grow past it.
strings.building.spore_harvester.desc: Funnels drawing in a cloud of spores. Gathers more next to the flora.
strings.building.star_well.desc: Where the great work reached deepest, a well remains whose surface mirrors the stars even by day.
strings.building.sky_lantern.desc: A pillar that reflects the light of the five satellites above the city at night. They say it can be seen from orbit.
strings.building.garden_tower.desc: A tower covered in gardens from base to spire. It cleans the air around it and stands for a smoke-free city.
strings.building.founders_stone.desc: Reward for the First Thousand challenge. A roughly hewn stone bearing the names of the first families — people stop by it and are glad to be here.
strings.building.log_cabin.desc: Reward for the Hard Winter challenge. Timber housing that stands in forest, taiga and snow — where an ordinary house won't go.
strings.building.builders_guild.desc: Reward for the By Hand challenge. The masters who built a city without a governor keep large stocks of wood, planks and stone.
strings.building.alley_house.desc: Reward for the City Without Roads challenge. A narrow house for dense alleys — many people in little space and no extra road.
strings.building.steam_generator.desc: A peat-fired boiler: a big heat source, and power besides.
strings.building.stilt_house.desc: Reward for The Flood challenge. A house on stilts by the water — people can live in swamps, mangroves and on beaches where other houses would sink.
strings.building.desert_gate.desc: Reward for the Only Sand challenge. A striped caravan gate into the city — a reminder that even a desert can be settled.
strings.building.castle_tower.desc: Reward for the On the Walls challenge. A stone tower with longer range and heavier fire than a watchtower. Defence games only.
strings.building.folk_school.desc: Reward for the No Books challenge. Lessons at the kitchen table: food turns into science and the village into a better place to live.
strings.building.lantern_square.desc: Reward for the Eternal Night challenge. A square full of lights where people gather after dark — and it is always dark here.
strings.building.sprinters_clock.desc: Reward for the Sprint challenge. A tall clock tower that timed the fastest start of all.
strings.building.hall_of_challenges.desc: Reward for completing every challenge. A great hall with a banner for each — for the one who mastered winter, flood, desert and night.
strings.building.star_gate.desc: The last megastructure. It is built not with time but with everything the city makes in surplus — four stages from foundations to activation. When it opens, the first chapter of your civilisation ends.
strings.building.stilt_hut.desc: A hut on stilts with a boardwalk: the tide flows beneath it. Built on tidal flats and in shallow water, where there's room.
strings.building.storm_eye.desc: The Aether's wonder: a vortex beneath the city tied to the Great Storm — in a wide circle it calms the bands, gives huge power and carries part of the city.
strings.building.storm_shield.desc: A mast with a blue field dome: within its reach the storm band strikes nothing.
strings.building.sulfur_mine.desc: Scrapes the yellow crusts around fumaroles. The more fumaroles nearby, the more sulfur.
strings.building.symbiont_spire.desc: A spiral tower overgrown with light — the densest housing on Xeno. Needs pearls from the Archipelago.
strings.building.symbiont_workshop.desc: A shell-like workshop: tools grow out of fiber and spores.
strings.building.terrace_house.desc: Stepped terraces that fit even on volcanic slopes where nothing else can be built. Denser housing.
strings.building.thermal_tower.desc: The densest housing on Rime. A tower wrapped in steam from heat cells.
strings.building.tidal_plant.desc: Turbines in a strait: power from water that flows in and out twice a day.
strings.building.tide_temple.desc: The wonder of the Archipelago, on the reef. Across a wide circle the tide falls still: the flats become lasting land and nothing on them floods.
strings.building.vertical_district.desc: A district built upwards — gardens, streets and homes stacked, arcology upon arcology. Unlocked at the planetary scale; the governor builds it from the centre out when land runs out.
strings.building.lake_drain.desc: Pumps on the lake shore. Each stage you fill with surplus drains one band of shore within eighteen tiles — the water retreats and leaves wet ground you can drain and build on. Twelve stages, each dearer.
strings.building.merchant_column.desc: The column where merchants seal their deals, raised once the city fulfilled fifty contracts.
strings.building.enduring_wall.desc: A stretch of wall remembering the hundred waves the city withstood. It no longer defends — it remembers.
strings.building.observatory.desc: An observatory. The best monument for research, and the first look upward.
strings.building.orbital_ring.desc: An orbital ring. Gathers power above the atmosphere and beams it down — enough for the whole agglomeration.
strings.building.park.desc: A park. A small patch of green that lifts the mood.
strings.building.particle_accelerator.desc: A particle accelerator. Turns silicon and computers into nanomaterial — the fastest road to it.
strings.building.plantation.desc: A plantation. Twice the food of a field, but it wants warmth.
strings.building.polder_mill.desc: Pumps the shallows behind a dyke dry and leaves land. Must stand by water.
strings.building.quarry.desc: Cuts stone from the rock around it. What is quarried does not grow back.
strings.building.radar_station.desc: Sweeps the horizon far beyond balloon range. Draws power and tools.
strings.building.research_lab.desc: A research lab. The most research of any building, but it wants electronics.
strings.building.roadMissing: No road connection — running at {0}%. A road appears on its own once another building goes up nearby.
strings.building.robotics_lab.desc: A robotics lab. Robots replace the hands a metropolis never has enough of.
strings.building.sawmill.desc: Cuts logs into planks. Almost everything past a hut wants planks.
strings.building.school.desc: A school. Three times a library's research, and people like having one.
strings.building.scout_balloon.desc: Rises above the land and slowly lifts the fog around it. More balloons see further.
strings.building.sea_dome.desc: A city under the surface. Housing where there is no land left.
strings.building.shrine.desc: A shrine. The first faith — it pays for prayers for rain and calm.
strings.building.silicon_mine.desc: A silicon mine. The base of everything with a circuit in it.
strings.building.smeltery.desc: A smeltery. Copper ore becomes bronze.
strings.building.soil_remediation.desc: Soil remediation. Cleans ground poisoned by spoil and slag.
strings.building.solar_array.desc: A solar array. Little power, but no smoke and no fuel.
strings.building.spaceport.desc: A spaceport. Satellites launch from here — the whole of orbit hangs on this one building.
strings.building.standing_stones.desc: A stone circle. The first monument a village can afford.
strings.building.statue_agronomist.desc: An agronomist's statue. For the one who taught the land to yield.
strings.building.statue_mason.desc: A statue of a master mason. Raised on its own when someone remarkable is born here.
strings.building.statue_navigator.desc: A navigator's statue. For the one who made this city a port.
strings.building.statue_scholar.desc: A scholar's statue. A reminder of who moved learning forward here.
strings.building.steel_mill.desc: A steel mill. Steel is the material of the whole industrial age.
strings.building.temple.desc: A temple. Four times the faith for a little food.
strings.building.tenement.desc: A tenement. Rented floors stacked tight — cheap housing for a growing city.
strings.building.terrace_row.desc: A merged terrace of tenements. Density without towers.
strings.building.timber_yard.desc: A merged timber yard. Four camps working as one.
strings.building.toolmaker.desc: A toolmaker's bench. Tools wear out, and nearly every later building wants them.
strings.building.townhouses.desc: Row houses from a merge. A city block, not a village.
strings.building.tree_nursery.desc: Replants the forest around it. Sawmills fell it faster than it grows back — this is the answer.
strings.building.triumphal_arch.desc: A triumphal arch. The strongest source of civic pride there is.
strings.building.university.desc: A university. Research at scale — from here the tech tree really moves.
strings.building.uranium_mine.desc: The one use for scorched fallout ground. It can be built nowhere else.
strings.building.vent_generator.desc: Takes power from a hot spring in the deep.
strings.building.volcanic_baths.desc: Terraces of hot water and steam — happiness. The water is heated with sulfur.
strings.building.warehouse.desc: A warehouse. Raises the ceiling on nearly every resource — without it production stalls on a full store.
strings.building.watchtower.desc: Shoots at whatever comes near. Short range, but it goes up at once.
strings.building.water_treatment.desc: A water treatment works. Gives the river and sea back what production poured in.
strings.building.weather_tower.desc: A tower with spinning anemometers: it measures the wind and the giant's bands and adds some science.
strings.building.well.desc: A stone ring with a windlass. Gives plenty of water, but can only be dug on an aquifer or in an oasis.
strings.building.wind_turbine.desc: A rotor on a boom in the giant's steady wind: modest but reliable power.
strings.building.windcatcher_tower.desc: A dense tower whose lattice catcher pulls cool air down. Houses many people and makes the street nicer to live in.
strings.building.windmill.desc: A windmill. It grinds, and it gives the village a place people like to look at.
strings.building.winter_harbor.desc: A pier with an icebreaker, Rime's port. Trade routes run through it; it must stand by water.
strings.building.winter_heart.desc: A giant geothermal core: heat for the whole centre, which will never freeze again. The aurora grows brighter above it.
strings.building.workshop.desc: A workshop. Tools from planks and stone, and a place people gather.
strings.building.world_anvil.desc: The Forge's wonder: a giant anvil over the crater tames the volcano — in a wide circle lava floods nothing, and the furnace beneath gives huge power.
strings.building.world_forge.desc: A world forge. Makes nanomaterial and steel at a scale no factory reaches.
strings.building.world_tree.desc: Xeno's wonder: a giant tree whose crown covers half the sky — the flora for a wide circle is tamed and wraps nothing, and at night the whole city glows.
strings.building.xeno_lander.desc: The colony under two suns: housing for thirty, storage, a little food and fiber and a small reactor. Keeps a link to the ship in orbit.
strings.building.xenobiology_institute.desc: A shell-shaped dome where the genome is studied: science and happiness.
strings.carillon.desc: Eight notes the city plays whenever it celebrates. Arrange them however you like.
strings.carillon.needsBells: Build a carillon first — there is nothing to ring with.

strings.devlog.ascend_and_goals.line1: Ascension (prestige): reset the era and keep permanent upgrades — production, harvesting, growth, housing, storage.
strings.devlog.ascend_and_goals.line2: Quests throughout the game — fixed ones and an endless dynamic one, with progress and rewards.
strings.devlog.ascend_and_goals.line3: Achievements that carry across every game (and are ready for Steam).
strings.devlog.ascend_and_goals.line4: A tech tree, building upgrades to higher tiers, and a build menu grouped by category.
strings.devlog.ascend_and_goals.line5: Minimap, goal tracker, toasts, and colour cues for what you can afford.
strings.devlog.ascend_and_goals.title: Ascension and goals
strings.devlog.come_back_and_click.line1: Offline progress and a daily reward — the civilization grows while you're away, and coming back pays off.
strings.devlog.come_back_and_click.line2: Harvest bubbles, golden spawns and critical harvests — more reasons to click.
strings.devlog.come_back_and_click.line3: Move and demolish buildings, plant groves, dig up caches — shape the world.
strings.devlog.come_back_and_click.line4: Festivals (a temporary boost), random events with choices, and clickable residents.
strings.devlog.come_back_and_click.line5: The HUD shows income per second and warns when storage is full.
strings.devlog.come_back_and_click.title: Come back and click
strings.devlog.foundations.line1: World generator with seeds and world types.
strings.devlog.foundations.line2: Placing buildings, production, and a population that eats.
strings.devlog.foundations.title: Foundations
strings.devlog.growing_civilization.line1: Automatic roads — new buildings connect themselves to the network.
strings.devlog.growing_civilization.line2: Clusters of houses are recognised as named settlements.
strings.devlog.growing_civilization.line3: Production chain wood → planks, and storage with real capacity.
strings.devlog.growing_civilization.line4: The village expands on its own as housing demand grows.
strings.devlog.growing_civilization.title: A growing civilization
strings.devlog.know_what_to_do.line1: A guided opening: one highlighted next step at a time, with a sentence on how to do it and a button that opens whatever it needs.
strings.devlog.know_what_to_do.line2: Workers now go where the city is short, building by building. Building more never slows down what you already have.
strings.devlog.know_what_to_do.line3: Terraforming grew into a real tool — irrigate, drain, level, afforest, thaw — unlocked by research.
strings.devlog.know_what_to_do.line4: Every building has its own model, and every resource its own icon. No more coloured squares.
strings.devlog.know_what_to_do.line5: The tech tree is laid out as a star, tooltips say at a glance whether you can afford something, and carts follow the roads.
strings.devlog.know_what_to_do.line6: Autosave every two minutes and on the way out, a How to Play page, 65 achievements, and historical city names.
strings.devlog.know_what_to_do.title: Knowing what to do
strings.devlog.living_map.line1: Day and night cycle — the town lights up after dark.
strings.devlog.living_map.line2: Biome decorations and ambient wildlife (fireflies included).
strings.devlog.living_map.line3: Clock and day counter in the HUD.
strings.devlog.living_map.title: A living map
strings.devlog.living_world.line1: Endless map — the world has no borders any more, it generates as you go.
strings.devlog.living_world.line2: Sprites and icons: trees, rocks, buildings and resources all have a face.
strings.devlog.living_world.line3: Felling has bite: a tree shrinks with every click and finally comes down.
strings.devlog.living_world.line4: People walk the streets and carts roll between buildings.
strings.devlog.living_world.line5: A living town grows in the menu — and this changelog lives there too.
strings.devlog.living_world.title: A living world
strings.devlog.scale_and_mood.line1: Zoom far out to see city density and total population — look how it grew.
strings.devlog.scale_and_mood.line2: Calm ambient music and a chime when a goal is met.
strings.devlog.scale_and_mood.line3: Soft shadows under trees and rocks plus a gentle vignette — the world sits better.
strings.devlog.scale_and_mood.title: Scale and mood
strings.doctrine.builders.desc: A civilisation known by what it leaves behind. More from gathering, more from production, bigger stores.
strings.doctrine.scholars.desc: A civilisation that knows things first. Faster research, cheaper tech, luck with finds.
strings.doctrine.settlers.desc: A civilisation that grows. More room, faster growth, louder festivals.
strings.doctrines.desc: The way this civilisation goes. Only one is ever active — and while nothing is bought, it can be changed.
strings.doctrines.locked: Refund first — the way changes only while nothing is bought.
strings.doctrines.resetHint: Ascension refunds the doctrine points and you choose again.
strings.doctrines.title: Doctrines
strings.election.family_league.desc: A quieter push: population grows 18% faster.
strings.election.foragers.desc: Gather what the land gives. Hand-harvesting +22%.
strings.election.industrialists.desc: Every workshop runs harder. Production +25% for the term.
strings.election.prospectors.desc: Everyone out with a pick. Hand-harvesting +40%.
strings.election.reformers.desc: Better streets, better mood. Happiness +12 points.
strings.election.settlers.desc: Open the gates — population grows 30% faster.
strings.election.subtitle: Your city votes for the next {0} days. Pick a platform.
strings.election.title: Election Day
strings.ending.galaxy.final.desc: The galaxy stays and runs on — nothing is erased. The worlds keep trading and growing, and your cities are waiting for you.
strings.ending.galaxy.final.replay: This was the end of the second chapter. The galaxy is waiting for you in the saved game.
strings.ending.galaxy.flight.subtitle: Six worlds, one light.
strings.ending.galaxy.flight.title: The Constellation lights up
strings.ending.galaxy.subtitle: From the first campfire through the gate to six worlds that live off one another. This is the story of your galaxy — world by world.
strings.ending.galaxy.title: The Galaxy Is One
strings.event.arch_bleaching.desc: Warm water is draining the reefs of colour. Let them rest, or keep quarrying?
strings.event.arch_cyclone_season.desc: The forecasters announce cyclone season. Reinforce the shore, or ride it out?
strings.event.arch_great_ebb.desc: The sea has pulled back further than ever. The flats are full of shells and an old wreck peeks out by the reef.
strings.event.arch_turtles.desc: Hundreds of sea turtles have crawled up the beaches. The whole archipelago wants to celebrate.
strings.event.arch_wreck.desc: The current has carried a broken ship to the shore. Its cargo would come in handy.
strings.event.berry_year.desc: Every bush within a day's walk is heavy with fruit.
strings.event.boiler_burst.desc: Steam scalded the wall and stopped the whole line.
strings.event.bronze_caster.desc: She casts better bronze than anyone, and she knows it.
strings.event.caravan.desc: Dusty traders roll in with more grain than they can carry home.
strings.event.chip_shortage.desc: Every fab on the continent is booked out for a year.
strings.event.collapsed_shaft.desc: Nobody was inside. The seam behind the rubble is the best one you have.
strings.event.collapsed_shaft.shore_up: Shore it up and dig on
strings.event.copper_find.desc: A shepherd brings down a stone streaked with green.
strings.event.data_center_heat.desc: The hall is running ten degrees over spec and climbing.
strings.event.dune_desert_bloom.desc: After a rare rain, flowers cover the desert. For a few days it feels almost like home.
strings.event.dune_dried_oasis.desc: The water in the oasis is sinking. It can be deepened — or you can wait for the water to return.
strings.event.dune_fata_morgana.desc: A city that doesn't exist floats above the dunes — towers, gardens and lakes.
strings.event.dune_mountain_caravan.desc: Traders from the mountains carry tools and dried meat. They want salt and glass.
strings.event.dune_storm_of_the_century.desc: The elders warn: a storm is rising on the horizon like none in a hundred years.
strings.event.factory_order.desc: A city downriver wants everything you can make, every month.
strings.event.fallen_tree.desc: A storm took down the biggest tree on the ridge.
strings.event.forge_new_island.desc: Lava has run into the sea and a smoking island of fresh basalt has risen off the coast.
strings.event.forge_rich_vein.desc: The miners have struck a vein so rich the ore glints violet.
strings.event.forge_side_vent.desc: A new vent has opened on the flank, smoking with sulfur. Study it, or start mining?
strings.event.forge_steam_clouds.desc: Rain has hit the hot crust and giant clouds of steam are rising over the city. Everyone is looking up.
strings.event.forge_sulfur_rain.desc: Acid drops are falling from the ash cloud. Shelter the people, or keep working?
strings.event.frost_aurora.desc: The sky ripples with green and violet bands. The whole town is outside.
strings.event.frost_avalanche.desc: An avalanche came down the slope and buried the road to the mines.
strings.event.frost_frozen_river.desc: The river froze to the bottom. You can walk on the ice — and cut it.
strings.event.frost_ice_floe.desc: A giant floe drifted to the shore, with seals basking on it.
strings.event.frost_return_of_sun.desc: After the polar night the sun shows above the horizon for the first time. People want to celebrate.
strings.event.gg_corona.desc: A rainbow corona has lit up around the sun. People stop on the deck and look up.
strings.event.gg_downdraft.desc: A strong downdraft is dragging the edge of the deck down. Add fiber to the braces, or let the city sway for a while?
strings.event.gg_eclipse.desc: One of the moons has covered the sun and darkness falls over the clouds. Lightning lights the clouds from within.
strings.event.gg_great_storm.desc: The forecasters report that the edge of the Great Storm is turning toward the city. Reinforce the ropes, or ride it out?
strings.event.gg_sky_whales.desc: A pod of giant sky whales is drifting slowly beneath the city. Their song can be heard across the whole deck.
strings.event.granary_rats.desc: Something is eating better than the town is.
strings.event.guild_charter.desc: Sign, and the craftsmen answer to the guild — and to their standards.
strings.event.harvest_festival.desc: The first good harvest deserves a night of noise and firelight.
strings.event.iron_prospector.desc: He wants a season of food up front and swears the ore is there.
strings.event.longevity_trial.desc: The clinic needs volunteers and is paying in food security for a decade.
strings.event.lost_child.desc: Someone wandered past the treeline and has not come back.
strings.event.orbital_contract.desc: Lift capacity, paid in materials you cannot buy on the ground.
strings.event.power_surge.desc: Half the district went dark and the substation is smoking.
strings.event.rail_survey.desc: A line through the hills would halve the haul from the mines.
strings.event.river_flood.desc: The low fields are underwater, but the silt they leave is black and rich.
strings.event.rogue_swarm.desc: Your assemblers are building something nobody specified.
strings.event.scholar.desc: She offers to write down everything your carpenters know.
strings.event.smith_apprentice.desc: Fourteen, stubborn, and already better than half your smiths.
strings.event.startup_pitch.desc: They have no product yet, but the plan is very good.
strings.event.stone_seam.desc: Rain has stripped the hillside down to clean grey rock.
strings.event.strike.desc: They want shorter shifts. They are not wrong.
strings.event.timber_deal.desc: The trader will go either way — he just wants the margin.
strings.event.toolsmith_visit.desc: He has a forge two valleys over and a full order book.
strings.event.traveler.desc: Half-starved, but he says he knows where the good stone lies.
strings.event.wandering_mason.desc: He works for meals and moves on when the work runs out.
strings.event.xeno_eclipse.desc: A moon has covered both suns and everything around has lit up. The whole city stands and stares.
strings.event.xeno_forest_song.desc: The flora is singing in the night — the tones carry through the whole city. Listen, or gather nectar while it blooms?
strings.event.xeno_great_bloom.desc: The whole flora has burst into bloom at once. Harvest the spores, or just watch?
strings.event.xeno_nest_awakens.desc: A nest near the city has woken and is pulsing. Study it, or prune it while there's time?
strings.event.xeno_spore_swarm.desc: The nests have released a cloud of spores. Cover the workshops, or keep working in the haze?

strings.figures.empty: Nobody like that has been born here yet.

strings.governor.categories.hint: A disabled category is never built, even if the city needs it. That is your order, not a bug.
strings.governor.desc: The governor upgrades your buildings on its own. Higher levels cover more categories and do more upgrades at once.
strings.governor.need.lavadam: The next lava will flow through buildings → a wall across its path
strings.governor.need.network: Buildings are out of the network ({0}) → a source nearby
strings.governor.need.platform: The deck is running out of room → the governor extends it
strings.governor.need.protection: A storm buried buildings → a shelter next to them
strings.governor.status.noSite: Governor is stuck: nowhere to build {0}
strings.governor.status.needsPeople: Governor is waiting for people — producers lack workers
strings.governor.status.slowSupply: Governor has been waiting long for {0}
strings.governor.status.bootstrap: Governor is stuck: not enough {0} for even one producer
strings.governor.status.gathering: Governor sends people to gather {0} for {1}
strings.governor.hint.building: The governor builds whatever the city needs most: food, housing, services, materials.
strings.governor.hint.saving: Producers leave this material for the build instead of using it up. Want it faster? Build another producer.
strings.governor.hint.noProducer: No available building makes this resource. Research one, or place it by hand on suitable terrain.
strings.governor.hint.noSite: The building needs terrain (forest, rock, coast) or free space the city can't reach. Place it by hand or extend a road.
strings.governor.hint.needsPeople: New producers would stand idle too. People will come on their own once there's housing and food.
strings.governor.hint.slowSupply: The resource trickles in too slowly. Build another producer, check its inputs, or expand storage.
strings.governor.hint.bootstrap: Building the producer takes the very resource it makes. Harvest a little by hand and the governor will carry on.
strings.governor.hint.gathering: Without this resource not even the first producer can be built, so jobless people gather it by hand. Clicking the map speeds it up.
strings.governor.focus.noBuild: The governor will not expand the city — only improve what stands.
strings.governor.focus.noUpgrade: The governor will not upgrade anything — only build new.
strings.governor.locked3: Top level: research the City Planning Office
strings.governor.mergeDesc: When a 2x2 square of identical buildings appears, the governor rebuilds it into one larger building — one per interval, so you can watch it happen.
strings.governor.mergeLocked: Research Urban Planning and the governor can merge blocks for you.
strings.governor.pace: Build pace: every {0} s, {1} buildings at a time
strings.governor.plan.none: The town lacks nothing right now.
strings.governor.need.food: Food is running low → farms, fisheries
strings.governor.need.inputs: Production is missing {0} → feed the chain
strings.governor.need.services: People lack services → market, park, school
strings.governor.need.housing: People have nowhere to live → houses
strings.governor.need.landscape: The land around {0} is stripped → tree nursery
strings.governor.need.knowledge: The next research needs more {0} → library, school
strings.governor.need.jobs: People without work → a new workshop
strings.governor.researchDesc: The governor researches whatever is next (the cheapest available technology) as soon as it can afford it. It never touches your reserve or what it is saving for a building.
strings.governor.reserveDesc: How much of your stock the governor must leave alone. Without a reserve it will spend even what you were saving for that one building.
strings.governor.title: Governor — upgrade management
strings.grandwork.desc: A bottomless build. Pour in the surplus you have nowhere else to put — each finished stage grants a permanent bonus that survives Ascension.
strings.grandwork.locked: Unlocks after your first Ascension — before that there is no surplus.
strings.grandwork.title: Grand Work
strings.hazard.lava.soon: lava will pour from the vent near town
strings.hint.contractReady: A contract on the board is ready — just hand it over.
strings.hint.idleBuildings: Some buildings sit empty. Build housing, or tear them down.
strings.hint.smog: Smog hangs over the city. Cleanup plants take it back — or move industry further out.
strings.hint.storageFull: Storage is overflowing and output is being wasted. Build storage, or spend it.
strings.hint.unhappy: People are unhappy. Either services are missing, or it is too crowded.
strings.howto.1: 1 · Click the map. Trees, rocks and bushes give resources. Hand-harvesting is your entire income at the start.
strings.howto.2: 2 · Build. Houses raise the population ceiling, farms feed it, camps and mines gather for you so you can stop clicking.
strings.howto.3: 3 · Population is the engine. People staff buildings; an understaffed city produces less of everything.
strings.howto.4: 4 · Research. The tech tree unlocks better buildings, new resources and whole eras.
strings.howto.5: 5 · Ascend. Once your city is big enough you can restart at a larger scale, keeping permanent bonuses.
strings.howto.6: 6 · The goal: turn one settlement into an agglomeration of millions. The tracker on the left always names your next step.
strings.howto.intro: CivDle is an idle city-builder. You light the first spark by hand; after that the city works on its own — while you watch, and while you are away.
strings.howto.modes: Optional modes (defence, sandbox) are switched on when a world is created — in the main menu under “New game”. A game in progress cannot change them.
strings.howto.more.1: · Where it stalls — a colour map of why buildings are idle. Toolbar button or B.
strings.howto.more.2: · Power coverage (E) and reach below the surface (M) — toolbar buttons as well.
strings.howto.more.3: · Anomalies — purple diamonds on the map. Click one and set out for it.
strings.howto.more.4: · Orbit — build a spaceport and a toolbar button appears, with satellites behind it.
strings.howto.more.5: · Doctrines — the way your civilisation goes, bought with ascension points. Only one at a time.
strings.howto.more.6: · Subsea — a harbour opens the sea around it and you can build on the seabed.
strings.howto.more.7: · Production chains — when you do not know what to build, start from what is running out.
strings.howto.more.title: Everything the game has

strings.quest.arch_first_stilts.desc: Build 3 stilt huts — the tide can't hurt them on the flats.
strings.quest.arch_star_land.desc: Win 200 tiles of land from the sea (polders or manual reshaping).
strings.quest.arch_star_master.desc: Weather 5 cyclones without the surf burying anything.
strings.quest.dune_first_well.desc: Dig the first well on an aquifer.
strings.quest.dune_star_master.desc: Reach 25,000 people without desalination — only wells, dew and oases.
strings.quest.dune_star_storms.desc: Weather 10 sandstorms without a single one burying anything.
strings.quest.forge_first_walls.desc: Build 3 lava walls across the lava's path.
strings.quest.forge_star_calm.desc: Weather 5 eruptions without the lava flooding anything.
strings.quest.forge_star_master.desc: Let lava set into 300 tiles of new land.
strings.quest.frost_star_master.desc: Reach 20,000 inhabitants on geothermal heat alone — without a single steam generator.
strings.quest.frost_star_night.desc: Get through a whole polar night without a single frozen building.
strings.quest.gg_star_calm.desc: Weather 10 storm bands without lightning striking anything.
strings.quest.gg_star_master: ✦ A thousand tiles over the abyss
strings.quest.unite_the_galaxy.desc: Build the Constellation on the Homeworld and fill it with the goods of all six worlds. Beyond it waits the end of the second chapter.
strings.quest.xeno_star_calm.desc: Weather 10 flora pulses at the city without it wrapping anything — while at least half the free land around the city stays green.
strings.stall.buried: Buried by sand. People will dig it out by themselves — next time a sand fence nearby will protect it.
strings.stall.flooded: It stands on a tidal flat without stilts and the tide has flooded it. It comes back on its own at ebb — build on stilts on the flats.
strings.stall.overgrown: The flora has wrapped it. People will cut it free and it comes back on its own — next time a pruner or a Tree of Life nearby will protect it.
strings.stall.scorched: Lava has flooded it. Once the crust cools, people will get it running again — next time a wall across the lava's path will protect it.
strings.stall.struck: A storm band struck it. It will come back on its own — next time a storm shield nearby will protect it.

strings.policy.rapid_growth.desc: Auto-build and zones place more buildings per interval.

strings.prayer.bountiful_harvest.desc: Food arrives in the storehouse at once.
strings.prayer.cleansing.desc: The area is washed clean of pollution.
strings.prayer.deluge.desc: Takes what stands by the water — and at least cleans up after itself.
strings.prayer.fertility.desc: People arrive faster for a while.
strings.prayer.jubilee.desc: Declares a festival — the city works double for a while.
strings.prayer.meteor.desc: Whatever stands near the target stops standing. Think it over.
strings.prayer.quickening.desc: The cleared land comes back at once. A tree nursery does it too — slowly and safely.
strings.prayer.rain.desc: The fields yield more for a while.
strings.prayer.revelation.desc: The fog around the target parts.
strings.prayer.windfall.desc: A gift to the storehouse. What arrives is not known in advance.
strings.prestige.carnival.desc: Festivals speed up production even more.
strings.prestige.cartographers.desc: Far more caches — exploring becomes an economy of its own.
strings.prestige.grand_carnival.desc: Festivals are far stronger — worth planning around.
strings.prestige.great_library.desc: Research is much cheaper still — the constellation opens up faster.
strings.prestige.inherit.none: nothing — inheritance is bought with Legacy points
strings.prestige.legacy.desc: New eras start with double starting resources.
strings.prestige.leviathan.desc: Catches of a lifetime come far more often.
strings.prestige.lucky_hands.desc: Higher chance of a critical harvest — any click can pay out several times over.
strings.prestige.master_builders.desc: The city sprawls on its own noticeably faster. Compounds per level.
strings.prestige.masters_touch.desc: Even higher critical harvest chance. Playing actively pays off.
strings.prestige.night_shift.desc: Offline progress +50% (what runs while you're away).
strings.prestige.open_academies.desc: Shortens the automatic research delay. Without Scholars of Their Own there is nothing to speed up.
strings.prestige.pathfinders.desc: More caches hidden across the map.

strings.prestige.sleepless_city.desc: Offline progress is twice as effective.
strings.prestige.spendNow: You have unspent points — spend them in the upgrade list below.

strings.prestige.whale_song.desc: Rarely a harvest lands the catch of a lifetime — a whale at sea, a giant vein in the mountains. The payout is enormous.
strings.prestige.world_engine.desc: A major leap in output for every building.
strings.quest.dynamic.desc: Reach {0} population — and it keeps going.
strings.quest.explore_the_map.desc: Uncover a stretch of the world from the fog.
strings.quest.great_billion.desc: Give a billion people a home. Unlocks the Billion Pillar.
strings.quest.great_metropolises.desc: Grow three settlements into metropolises. Unlocks the Boulevard Arch.
strings.quest.great_reclaim.desc: Reshape 2,000 tiles of land. Unlocks the Reclaimers' Statue.
strings.quest.great_megastructures.desc: Complete seven different megastructures. Unlocks the Hall of Wonders.
strings.quest.great_depth.desc: Take the great work to stage 25. Unlocks the Star Well.
strings.quest.great_sky.desc: Launch five satellites into orbit. Unlocks the Sky Lantern.
strings.quest.great_clean_air.desc: With a hundred million people, keep the air over the city 95% clean. Unlocks the Garden Tower.
strings.quest.great_market.desc: Fulfil 50 contracts within one scale. Unlocks the Merchants' Column.
strings.quest.great_defense.desc: Withstand a hundred waves in defence mode. Unlocks the Wall of the Steadfast.
strings.quest.open_the_gate.desc: Build the Star Gate and fill all four of its stages. Beyond it waits the end of the first chapter.
strings.quest.first_merge_quest.desc: Merge four identical buildings into one.
strings.quest.meet_the_world.desc: Bring one foreign city into your realm.
strings.quest.plant_first.desc: Plant your first tree — planted growth regrows, so the wood keeps coming.
strings.quest.plant_grove.desc: Plant ten trees. A grove next door beats hiking for timber.
strings.quest.raise_a_wonder.desc: Wonders take minutes, not a click — start one and let it rise
strings.resource.kelp.desc: Grown on the seabed; feed for the fish pens.

strings.satellite.comm_array.desc: Links laboratories across the planet. Research +15% each.
strings.satellite.orbital_depot.desc: Stock beyond the reach of weather. Storage +18% each.
strings.satellite.solar_mirror.desc: Lights the shadows of your cities. All production +10% each.
strings.satellite.survey_eye.desc: Sees past the horizon. Discovery luck +20% each.
strings.satellite.weather_watch.desc: Sees the storm before it arrives. Growth +12% each.
strings.scenario.by_hand.desc: The governor is off duty. Build a hundred and twenty buildings yourself within forty minutes.
strings.scenario.costly_upkeep.desc: Every service costs twice as much to run. Build temples and schools carelessly and you go broke. Place services so that few are enough.
strings.scenario.eternal_night.desc: The sun never rises. Fields yield little without it; the city lives on its lights and whatever it can grow in the dark.
strings.scenario.first_thousand.desc: Get a thousand people into the city within forty-five minutes. Ascension is closed — this run has to be finished.
strings.scenario.great_flood.desc: The sea has risen and the land is down to islets. Every tile of ground is precious — build densely and take what the water gives.
strings.scenario.hard_winter.desc: An archipelago where people eat more and arrive slowly. Hold three hundred within half an hour — and do not let the city die out.
strings.scenario.no_books.desc: Research is forbidden. You play only with what people know from the start — and it has to be enough.
strings.scenario.no_roads.desc: No roads can be built. Goods are carried on backs and every workshop runs slower — the city has to stay tight and close.
strings.scenario.on_the_walls.desc: Attacks start at once and come more often. Build towers before palaces and hold out until they stop.
strings.scenario.only_sand.desc: The whole world is desert. Forest, meadow and rock survive only in scattered oases — find them and build where the water is.
strings.scenario.sprint.desc: An ordinary world with unusually little time. Every minute the city is not building is missing at the end.
strings.scenario.lost: The scenario did not work out.

strings.scenarios.rule.singleBiome: All land is one biome; resources only in oases.
strings.scenarios.rule.defenceFromStart: Defence from the first minute; waves come more often.

strings.tech.adobe_drying.desc: Unlocks the courtyard house — more people on the same water.
strings.tech.aerogel.desc: Light as a cloud: the aerogel kiln and cloud spires.
strings.tech.aeronautics.desc: What rises sees further than anyone on foot. Unlocks the scout balloon.
strings.tech.airships.desc: The airship dock and the sky gallery.
strings.tech.alloys.desc: Unlocks the bronze smith (bronze + planks → tools).
strings.tech.antigravity.desc: Anchors that carry the city without fuel.
strings.tech.apprenticeships.desc: A master trains a successor and saves himself the work. Research 5 % cheaper per level.
strings.tech.astronomy.desc: An observatory to look further than the next valley.
strings.tech.auto: Scholars of their own: {0} research every {1} s (paid from your resources)
strings.tech.aviation.desc: Unlocks the airfield — fast transport and big storage.
strings.tech.biocrystals.desc: The biocrystal hatchery and the signal bloom for export.
strings.tech.black_powder.desc: One charge and the rock comes down. Manual harvest +30 % per level.
strings.tech.botany.desc: Botanical gardens — the finest green space a city can have.
strings.tech.bronze_working.desc: Unlocks the copper mine and smeltery — enter the Bronze Age.
strings.tech.caravans.desc: The caravanserai: Dune's port for trade routes.
strings.tech.cellars.desc: Underground it stays cool all year. Storage capacity +10 % per level.
