strings.tech.computing.desc: Unlocks the computer plant (electronics + parts → computers).
strings.tech.constellation_theory.desc: How to join six worlds into one light. Unlocks the Constellation — it can be built once the gate is open and finished only with imports from all six worlds.
strings.tech.crop_terraces.desc: Even a slope can be ploughed once you cut it into steps. Food production +6 % per level.
strings.tech.crucibles.desc: A proper crucible never scorches the melt. Bronze production +7 % per level.
strings.tech.crystal_cutting.desc: The crystal cutter and the winter harbour for trade routes.
strings.tech.crystallography.desc: Crystal mines and the aurora observatory.
strings.tech.decontamination.desc: The crater can be given back to the land. Unlocks the yard and the terraforming option.
strings.tech.deep_diving.desc: Lets you build in the deep ocean too.
strings.tech.deep_sounding.desc: A cable into the giant's interior for metallic hydrogen.
strings.tech.drainage.desc: Sewers and trenches take the water out of the swamp — and buildable soil is left.
strings.tech.dynamite.desc: Safer than black powder and far, far stronger. Manual harvest +45 % per level.
strings.tech.earthmoving.desc: Heavy machinery: levelling mountains and thawing glaciers.
strings.tech.electrification.desc: Unlocks the coal power plant and factory — factories need power.
strings.tech.electronics.desc: Unlocks the silicon mine and electronics fab — the Information Age.
strings.tech.environmental_engineering.desc: Unlocks the air scrubber and the water treatment plant.
strings.tech.exosuit_mining.desc: In an exosuit the pick weighs nothing and the streak never breaks. Combo power +80 % per level (longer streaks, bigger steps).
strings.tech.ferries.desc: Docks and a shipyard: islands linked across the water.
strings.tech.festival_lanterns.desc: The lights over the square last until morning. Festival power +10 % per level.
strings.tech.fire_setting.desc: Heat the rock, douse it, and it cracks on its own. Manual harvest +20 % per level.
strings.tech.fishing.desc: Better nets and drying: all food production +25%.
strings.tech.flint_picks.desc: Sharp flint bites deeper into the seam than a bare hand. Manual harvest +12 % per level.
strings.tech.forestry.desc: Planned planting: woods can be founded, not only felled.
strings.tech.fusion.desc: Unlocks the fusion plant and nano forge — the age of the future.
strings.tech.genetics.desc: Reading Xeno's genome: the lab and the symbiont workshop.
strings.tech.geothermal.desc: The earth's heat for power and for the baths.
strings.tech.geothermal_bores.desc: Bores on hot springs and thermal towers.
strings.tech.glass_oasis.desc: Plans for Dune's wonder: a dome under which the desert turns green.
strings.tech.glassmaking.desc: The glassworks melts sand into glass; the observatory grinds lenses from it.
strings.tech.grain_drying.desc: Dry grain survives the winter; damp grain rots in a month. Storage capacity +8 % per level.
strings.tech.graphHelp: Drag or WASD to pan · wheel to zoom · hover a star · click to research
strings.tech.great_excavation.desc: You can dig where there is nothing to find. Unlocks the Great Work — a vast pit for surpluses.
strings.tech.greenhouses.desc: Greenhouses yield a quarter more food.
strings.tech.grown_buildings.desc: Buildings that grow: the seed vault.
strings.tech.hafted_hammers.desc: A hafted hammer swings with the weight of the whole body. Manual harvest +15 % per level.
strings.tech.heat_cells.desc: The heat cell works and heat relays that carry heat further.
strings.tech.helium_separation.desc: Helium-3 from hydrogen — fusion fuel for the whole galaxy.
strings.tech.high_energy_physics.desc: Smashing particles pays off when science falls out. Unlocks the Particle Accelerator.
strings.tech.higher_education.desc: Unlocks the university — the scientific heart of a big city.
strings.tech.hydraulic_hammers.desc: A machine that hammers the rock until it gives. Manual harvest +60 % per level.
strings.tech.hydro_engineering.desc: Dams, weirs and dredgers: water can be led where there never was any.
strings.tech.hydrogen_lift.desc: Big hydrogen lifters and houses hung beneath the deck.
strings.tech.hydrothermal_tapping.desc: Vents give power, and a smelter right on the floor.
strings.tech.ice_insulation.desc: Habitat domes and hot springs spas.
strings.tech.industrial_estates.desc: Merge lumber camps and quarries into large works.
strings.tech.iron_working.desc: Unlocks iron and coal mines and the blast furnace — the Iron Age.
strings.tech.irrigation.desc: Ditches and channels: dry ground can become meadow long before heavy machinery arrives.
strings.tech.land_reclamation.desc: Unlocks soil remediation — poisoned ground can be brought back.
strings.tech.lava_channels.desc: A river of fire can be led along a bed wherever you want it.
strings.tech.ledgers.desc: What is written down does not go missing. Storage capacity +6 % per level.
strings.tech.life_tree.desc: Taming the flora: the Tree of Life, serenity gardens and healing groves.
strings.tech.lookout_posts.desc: See further, find sooner. Discovery chance +6 % per level.
strings.tech.luminescence.desc: The flora's light as power: glow fields.
strings.tech.magma_power.desc: A probe right above the magma — huge power. And towers overlooking the lava.
strings.tech.market_scales.desc: An honest scale brings the traders back. Production +4 % per level.
strings.tech.megaliths.desc: Standing stones and obelisks: the first things built to be seen.
strings.tech.merchant_charters.desc: Cities win the right to hold a great market. Unlocks the Grand Exchange.
strings.tech.meteorology.desc: Measuring the giant's wind and bands.
strings.tech.monumental_art.desc: Cast a statue that outlives everyone who raised it.
strings.tech.municipal_administration.desc: Unlocks the governor's upgrade management — the city starts modernising itself.
strings.tech.night_shifts.desc: The workshop never goes dark. Production +4 % per level.
strings.tech.nuclear_fission.desc: One nucleus releases more energy than a wagon of coal. Unlocks the nuclear plant.
strings.tech.obsidian.desc: Volcanic glass for sharp tools. Obsidian workshop and smithy.
strings.tech.orbital_construction.desc: You can build where there is nothing to stand on. Unlocks the Orbital Ring.
strings.tech.pearl_diving.desc: Pearl farms, the shell shrine and lagoon villas.
strings.tech.peat_stoves.desc: Hearth houses that warm their neighbours too.
strings.tech.pneumatic_drills.desc: Compressed air never tires. Combo power +40 % per level (longer streaks, bigger steps).
strings.tech.polders.desc: Wind pumps turn the flats into land.
strings.tech.priesthood.desc: Unlocks the temple: more faith and room for priests.
strings.tech.public_gardens.desc: Parks — green space that keeps the city content.
strings.tech.public_works.desc: The city office gets its own crew. The governor builds 35 % faster.
strings.tech.pyrocrete.desc: Basalt and sulfur into a concrete that withstands heat. Mixer and dome houses.
strings.tech.qanats.desc: Underground channels that carry water far from the well.
strings.tech.quenching.desc: Mist from nozzles chills the lava before it reaches the houses.
strings.tech.radar.desc: The horizon can be searched without eyes. Unlocks the radar station.
strings.tech.radiochemistry.desc: The impact ground yields something after all. Unlocks the uranium mine.
strings.tech.rare_earths.desc: The richest veins in the galaxy: mine, refinery and ore exchange for export.
strings.tech.rhythm_of_the_pick.desc: Keep the rhythm and no swing is wasted. Combo power +25 % per level (longer streaks, bigger steps).
strings.tech.rituals.desc: Unlocks the shrine — the first building that carries faith.
strings.tech.robotics.desc: Unlocks the robotics lab (computers + nanomaterial → robots).
strings.tech.rocketry.desc: The first step out of the atmosphere. Unlocks the Spaceport — and with it, orbit.
strings.tech.rope_making.desc: Rope pulls what hands cannot carry. Plank production +5 % per level.
strings.tech.ropemaking.desc: Rope from bamboo and kelp — for boats, rafts and export.
strings.tech.sacred_architecture.desc: A cathedral: generations of work, visible from everywhere.
strings.tech.salt_works.desc: Salt pans on the salt flats.
strings.tech.schooling.desc: Unlocks the school: more science and room for more scholars.
strings.tech.scientific_method.desc: Unlocks the research institute: science at industrial scale.
strings.tech.scriptoria.desc: A grand library. Knowledge worth housing properly.
strings.tech.seed_selection.desc: The best ear of grain becomes next year sowing. Wood production +6 % per level.
strings.tech.shaft_sinking.desc: Below the surface lie seams no surface digging will reach. Manual harvest +22 % per level.
strings.tech.shift_songs.desc: They sing to keep time, and time keeps the takings up. Combo power +30 % per level (longer streaks, bigger steps).
strings.tech.shipbuilding.desc: The floating market — the world's port for trade routes.
strings.tech.silviculture.desc: Forest can be grown, not only cut. Unlocks the tree nursery.
strings.tech.sky_palaces.desc: Luxury over the abyss — with pearls and glass from other worlds.
strings.tech.snowplows.desc: The snowplow depot shields its surroundings from blizzards.
strings.tech.solar_mirrors.desc: Power from the sun — plenty at noon, none at night.
strings.tech.spice_craft.desc: Spice gardens, and the oasis palace that wants spice.
strings.tech.spires.desc: Xeno's densest housing — with pearls from another world.
strings.tech.spore_barriers.desc: Barriers and root networks the flora can't grow past.
strings.tech.standard_plans.desc: A layout that works does not get drawn twice. Unlocks building templates.
strings.tech.steam_heat.desc: Steam generator: plenty of heat and power from peat.
strings.tech.steam_power.desc: Unlocks the steel mill (iron + coal → steel) — the rise of industry.
strings.tech.stellar_engineering.desc: Light your own sun above the city. Unlocks the Fusion Beacon.
strings.tech.gate_theory.desc: How to turn a fusion sun into a door and open the way beyond. Unlocks the Star Gate — it can be built once all seven technical wonders stand.
strings.tech.stilt_building.desc: Floating houses in the shallows and a lighthouse.
strings.tech.stone_sledges.desc: Stone is not dragged — stone is hauled. Stone production +6 % per level.
strings.tech.storm_eye.desc: The Aether's wonder: tying the city to the Great Storm.
strings.tech.storm_power.desc: Lightning harvesters: the storm as a power source.
strings.tech.storm_shields.desc: A field in which lightning doesn't strike.
strings.tech.street_wells.desc: Water within reach means more children reaching adulthood. Population growth +6 % per level.
strings.tech.submersibles.desc: Opens building in the shallows around harbours.
strings.tech.surveying.desc: Surveyed country hides fewer surprises. Discovery chance +5 % per level.
strings.tech.symbiosis.desc: Living with the flora, not against it: living hives and canopy houses.
strings.tech.terraces.desc: Building into the slope: dense terrace houses even on volcanic flanks.
strings.tech.terraforming.desc: Unlocks reshaping the land — irrigation, drainage and afforestation.
strings.tech.theology.desc: Unlocks the monastery — faith and learning under one roof.
strings.tech.tidal_power.desc: Turbines in the straits power the shipyards.
strings.tech.tide_temple.desc: The Archipelago's wonder: around the temple the tide falls still.
strings.tech.tiled_roofs.desc: A fired tile beats thatch to live under. Housing from buildings +7 % per level.
strings.tech.needsStorage: ▸ You need more storage: {1} {0}, but only {2} fits. Build storage.
strings.tech.toolsmithing.desc: Unlocks the iron forge (iron → many tools).
strings.tech.unknown.desc: You cannot see this far yet. Research what lies closer to the centre and it will show itself.
strings.tech.urban_planning.desc: Merge brick houses and tenements into whole city blocks.
strings.tech.vulcanology.desc: Listening to the volcano: the seismograph shows the path of the next lava.
strings.tech.watchtowers.desc: Unlocks defensive towers. Only useful in defence mode.
strings.tech.water_management.desc: Cisterns carry water further, and the hammam turns it into happiness.
strings.tech.waterworks.desc: Fountain squares: a place to meet, and clean water.
strings.tech.windbreaks.desc: Sand fences protect against sandstorms; the windcatcher lets you build tall.
strings.tech.windpumps.desc: A mill that grinds nothing but pumps. Behind the dyke, land stays where the sea was.
strings.tech.winter_heart.desc: Rime's wonder: a centre that never freezes.
strings.tech.works_department.desc: The governor can hold off building when it would drain storage below your reserve.
strings.tech.world_anvil.desc: The Forge's wonder: taming the volcano.
strings.tech.world_tree.desc: Xeno's wonder: taming the flora all around.
strings.tech.writing.desc: Unlocks the library — the first building that makes science.
strings.tech.xenobiology.desc: An institute that turns genome into science.
strings.templates.clipboardFailed: Could not put it on the clipboard.
strings.templates.copied: The code is on your clipboard — send it to whoever you like.
strings.templates.desc: Drag over finished blocks to save their layout. Place a saved template with one click — at full price; whatever does not fit is skipped.
strings.templates.empty: No templates yet. Capture your first — a block of houses with a street, say.
strings.templates.pasteFailed: There is no template code on the clipboard.
strings.templates.title: Building templates
strings.terraform.afforest.desc: Plants a forest on open plains — wood, and better output from buildings.
strings.terraform.break_ice.desc: Breaks the sheet apart and opens the water beneath it.
strings.terraform.decontaminate.desc: Hauls the scorched soil away and puts meadow back in its place.
strings.terraform.deepen.desc: Turns sea into the deep — the deepest water on the map.
strings.terraform.drain.desc: Dries out a swamp and leaves firm ground you can build on.
strings.terraform.dredge.desc: Turns shallows into open sea. Deeper water carries bigger ports and ships.
strings.terraform.flood.desc: Lets water onto the tile — a lake, a pond or a river bed. Not under a building or a road.
strings.terraform.irrigate.desc: Brings water to dry ground — desert, steppe and tundra turn to grassland.
strings.terraform.lay_deck.desc: Turns clouds into deck — a piece of platform you can build on. Without a deck nothing stands on the Aether.
strings.terraform.level.desc: Cuts away rock and flattens the ground. Expensive, but it opens the mountains up.
strings.terraform.reclaim.desc: Turns shallows into solid ground. Expensive, but the sea retreats and meadow is left.
strings.terraform.reclaim_flat.desc: Turns tidal flats and shallow water into beach — solid ground the tide won't flood. Leaves living reef alone.
strings.terraform.shoal.desc: Fills the deep with rock up to sea level. The first step in taking space back from the water.
strings.terraform.silt.desc: Silts the sea up into shallows. The second step from the deep to dry land.
strings.terraform.thaw.desc: Melts a glacier into tundra. A drastic answer for drastic places.
strings.timelapse.beforeAscend: One last look at how it grew
strings.timelapse.caption: {0} — {1} people, {2} buildings
strings.timelapse.collectionEmpty: Nothing here yet. A time-lapse is saved automatically on every Ascension — and manually from the player any time.
strings.timelapse.controls: Drag with the right button, zoom with the wheel · Space pauses
strings.timelapse.empty: Nothing to replay yet. Build for a while and come back.
strings.timelapse.title: Time-lapse
strings.tip.achievements: Achievement overview — shared across all your games.
strings.tip.ascend: Ascend: restart at a larger scale and keep your permanent upgrades.
strings.tip.backToCity: Snaps the camera back to the heart of your city.
strings.tip.batch: How many go down per click. Drag to build a whole row or block. (Tab cycles)
strings.tip.bottlenecks: Colours buildings by why they are not working. Key B.
strings.tip.build: Opens the building catalogue. Pick a building and click the map — the ghost shows where it fits.
strings.tip.build.buildTime: Takes {0} to build — gives nothing until finished
strings.tip.build.haul: Produces less far from storage — build one closer
strings.tip.build.madeGround: This ground does not occur naturally — you have to make it (a meteor crater, a flooded shore).
strings.tip.build.needsWater: Must be built next to water
strings.tip.build.powerRange: Power has a range — it must reach from a plant (E shows coverage).
strings.tip.build.subsea: Built on the seabed, only within reach of a harbour (M shows the reach).
strings.tip.build.terraforms: Reshapes its surroundings on its own: {0} (radius {1})
strings.tip.bulkBuild: Bulk building: hold the left button and drag — you get a row or a block. The ×5 and ×25 multipliers place a group in one click.
strings.tip.carillon: Compose the tune your city plays at a festival.
strings.tip.chains: What to build when something is running out.
strings.tip.challenges: Three challenges a day, the same for everyone. Progress counts what you do today.
strings.tip.chronicle: Records and discoveries that carry across every game you play.
strings.tip.chroniclePage: Your city's story in sentences — and on one picture.
strings.tip.citizens: Now and then a named citizen asks to open a trade of their own. Help them and the game builds it near the city — and that building carries their name for good.
strings.tip.contracts: Short orders on a deadline. Hand over a resource, get others back — and the more you deliver, the bigger the orders get. If one expires, nothing bad happens; it just leaves and another arrives.
strings.tip.day: Game time. Day and night change the mood of the map, not production.
strings.tip.discovery.desc: Something is buried here. Click to dig it up — once per spot.
strings.tip.district: A cluster of like buildings recognises itself as a quarter. Output there is better — but industry and power plants also foul more, which is why parks and cleanup plants belong next to them.
strings.tip.doctrines: Choose the way your civilisation will go.
strings.tip.election: A new election every few days. The winning platform gives your city a bonus for the term.
strings.tip.era: Your civilization's era. A new era unlocks buildings and technologies.
strings.tip.eraNext: The era you are heading for, and the technology that opens it.
strings.tip.faith: Prayers: you offer faith and hope. The stronger the prayer, the dearer it costs — and the less likely it is answered.
strings.tip.festival: Festival: speeds up all production {0}x for {1} s. Then a {2} s cooldown before the next one.
strings.tip.figures: Who was born here and what they left behind.
strings.tip.frontier: Waves of attackers. Towers shoot them down; whatever gets through damages a building until it repairs itself.
strings.tip.frontierPanel: When the next wave arrives and what stops it.
strings.tip.galaxy: Galaxy map: your worlds, colony ships and travel between them.
strings.tip.governor: Governor: growth policies and how eagerly the city upgrades its own buildings.
strings.tip.governorMerge: Merging is permanent. The governor does one block at a time.
strings.tip.happiness: How good life in the city is. Services (market, granary, workshop) raise it, overcrowding lowers it. Low happiness slows growth — it never costs anyone their life.
strings.tip.idleBuildings: These buildings have nobody to staff them, so they produce nothing. Workers go to the oldest buildings first — grow the population, or demolish what you do not need. The coloured corner on a building tells you what it is missing.
strings.tip.eventEffects: After-effects of your event choices. Each one ends — time left is in brackets.
strings.tip.landmark: A special spot on the map. Click it — it yields more than the ground around it.
strings.tip.merge: Four identical buildings in a 2x2 square become one larger building. Needs the right research.
strings.tip.milestones: The more buildings of one type you have, the better they all produce. Every {0}th one is another tier — building the same type over and over pays off.
strings.tip.networkOverlay: Shows where power and water reach. Press again to switch network. Key E.
strings.tip.objective: One step at a time. Finish it and the next one appears.
strings.tip.online: What is running, what is not, and what it means.
strings.tip.orbit: Satellites: global bonuses from orbit. Launched from a spaceport.
strings.tip.plant: Planting: click an empty tile to plant a tree. Forests regrow wood and change the biome underneath.
strings.tip.plantSpecies: Click to switch what you plant. More kinds unlock through research.
strings.tip.planted: Planted growth. Click to harvest; it stays put.
strings.tip.poi: Click an anomaly on the map and set out for it.
strings.tip.pollution: How much smog sits over the city. Industry fouls air, water and soil; cleanup plants take it back, but they cost upkeep. Put heavy industry away from housing — smog does spread, but it thins with distance.
strings.tip.power: Power grid: supply versus demand. A shortfall throttles buildings that need electricity.
strings.tip.powerOverlay: Shows how far each plant reaches. Key E.
strings.tip.prestigeCurrency: Permanent currencies. Ascension points are spent in Ascension, Legacy in Legacy — both survive a reset.
strings.tip.quests: Quests and rewards — your guide through the game. Completed quests pay out on their own.
strings.tip.questRetired: Quests your city has outgrown — automation did them its own way. They closed without a reward and come back if you start over from a village.
strings.tip.play: A new village on a hand-picked world — no choices, straight into the game.
strings.tip.customWorld: Pick the seed, world type and mode.
strings.tip.road: Lay roads yourself — drag to draw a street. Auto-roads only fill in what is missing.
strings.tip.roadErase: Tear up roads. Drag to clear a stretch.
strings.tip.sandbox: Resources are free. Achievements and leaderboards do not count in this run.
strings.tip.settlementPlan: What may be built in this city in particular.
strings.tip.settlements: List of settlements — jump the camera to any of them.
strings.tip.skipGuide: Hides the guide for good. The quest tracker stays.
strings.tip.speed: Game speed: pause, 1x, 2x, 4x. Click to cycle.
strings.tip.stats: My numbers: charts of the city's growth — population, buildings, happiness and more over time.
strings.tip.subseaOverlay: Shows where you can build on the seabed. Key M.
strings.tip.tech: Tech tree: a constellation of upgrades. Researching a node opens the ones beyond it.
strings.tip.templates: Save a piece of your city and rebuild it with one click.
strings.tip.terraform: Reshape the land: pick an action and click a tile. Unlocked by research.
strings.tip.tier: Scale earned through Ascension — sets your population cap and access to megastructures.
strings.tip.tools: How many people have tools. Equipped workers produce faster and gather more — but tools wear out with work, so they have to keep being made.
strings.tip.weather: Weather over your city. Extreme weather slows production for a while but never destroys anything.
strings.tip.zone: Zone: paint a rectangle and the city fills it in for you. Builds: {0}.
strings.tip.zones: Zone painting: pick a type and drag across tiles. The governor then fills the zone for you.
strings.toast.cityLevel: Ties with a foreign city grew stronger
strings.toast.cityLinked: Your road reached a foreign city
strings.toast.cityStruck: A foreign city was struck from the sky
strings.toast.floodNoWater: Too far from water — the prayer had nothing to flood.
strings.toast.scaleCapped: The city has hit the scale ceiling
strings.toast.scaleCapped.body: No more people fit at this scale. Ascending raises it.
strings.toast.storageFull: Storage full: {0} is being produced into the void
strings.toast.templateEmpty: Nothing stands in that selection — the template would be empty.
strings.toast.governor.noProducer: The governor has nothing that makes
strings.toast.governor.noSite: The governor has nowhere to build
strings.toast.governor.slowSupply: The governor has been waiting a long time for
strings.toast.governor.bootstrap: The governor cannot build its first producer — harvest some by hand
strings.tutorial.automate.hint: Build a lumber camp on the marked spot by the forest. Then just watch: producers work by themselves — this is where the game starts playing itself.
strings.tutorial.done: You are on your own now
strings.tutorial.done.hint: The guide is finished. Keep an eye on the quest tracker — it always has a next target.
strings.tutorial.feed.hint: Build a farm. People eat every day; when food runs out, growth stops dead.
strings.tutorial.gather.hint: Click the tree the arrow points at (and other trees and rocks). Hand-harvesting is your only income until something is built.
strings.tutorial.goal.hint: Grow to 40 people and keep going. At {0} people you can Ascend: the world scales up and permanent bonuses carry over.
strings.tutorial.grow.hint: Population is the engine: people staff your buildings, and understaffed buildings produce less.
strings.tutorial.refine.hint: Build a sawmill. Chains — wood into planks — are worth far more than raw resources.
strings.tutorial.replant.hint: Use the planting tool to put three new nodes down. A felled forest grows back only slowly, and quarried rock never does.
strings.tutorial.research.hint: Research milling. Technology unlocks better buildings and, eventually, whole new eras.
strings.tutorial.shelter.hint: The house is already selected — click the marked spot. Housing is the ceiling your population grows towards; without it nobody moves in.
strings.ufo.abduction: A UFO abducted a few residents. Let's hope they come back.
strings.ufo.beam_house: A beam from the sky took one building apart, atom by atom.
strings.ufo.crop_circle: Crop circles appeared overnight — and there's something to harvest in them.
strings.ufo.flyby: A light passed over the city. Nothing happened. Yet.
strings.ufo.gift: The visitors left something behind. It seems useful.
strings.ufo.terraform: A patch of land turned into something else overnight.
strings.undo.worldChanged: Cannot undo — something else stands there now.
strings.video.recording: Recording camera move — F9 stops and starts the render
strings.video.tooShort: That take is too short to render

strings.world.archipelago.desc: A tropical sea of atolls and lagoons. Land is scarce and every tile is precious — build on stilts, farm pearls and wrest new land from the sea.
strings.world.archipelago.rule: Tides: the shallows flood and drain in turn.
strings.world.dune.desc: A scorching world of dunes, mesas and salt flats. The city grows along the water like a necklace of oases, and sandstorms bury whatever no windbreak protects.
strings.world.dune.rule: Water is everything: buildings only work within reach of the water network.
strings.world.forge.desc: A young world of volcanoes and basalt plateaus with the richest ores in the galaxy. Build dams, channel the lava and reap harvests from the ash.
strings.world.forge.rule: Eruptions: lava runs downhill and knocks out whatever stands in its way.
strings.world.frost.desc: Glaciers, tundra and hot springs. The city is an island of warmth in a white waste; the polar night is long and blizzards bury the roads.
strings.world.frost.rule: Heat is life: a building without heat freezes.
strings.world.gas_giant.desc: A gas giant of cloud bands, rings and moons. The city hangs above an ocean of clouds; storm bands knock out and power it, and sky whales drift beneath.
strings.world.gas_giant.rule: No ground: the city stands on platforms held up by lift.
strings.world.home.desc: Where it all began. The Homeworld makes machines, electronics and robots for the colonies, takes in their luxuries and builds their ships.
strings.world.home.rule: Your capital: the industrial heart of the galaxy.
strings.world.xeno.desc: A living world under two suns, covered in bioluminescent flora that behaves like one organism. Here you don't build — you grow.
strings.world.xeno.rule: The flora spreads: it overgrows roads and wraps buildings — prune and cultivate.
